column1: # Mortal Kombat 1 for Nintendo Switch, update v1900544 (1.29.0), SDK 15.3.2.
# NetherRealm Studios' Unreal Engine game; NVN, Havok and Wwise. Profile brought up on the Mac.
# The supplied v1835008 add-on package is license-only; it contains no game content.

# the NPDM declares 12 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# the NPDM declares 12 MB of system resource
# The game selects near-zero depth; offline pipeline bases use the same mode.
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
# The Mac build provided a 64 GB alias region; this game's runtime region use exceeds the iPhone layout and has not been checked there.
